Workload details

Symmetry
U(1) symmetry
Center bond dimension
128
Meaning of center bond dimension
Full virtual-space dimension: sum each symmetry sector's multiplicity times its irreducible representation dimension
Base tensor
rank 4: left virtual bond, physical leg, purification leg, and right virtual bond
Bra center tensor
5 legs, including physical and purification legs and an extra global charge leg
Ket center tensor
5 legs, including physical and purification legs and an extra global charge leg
Physical leg
spinless fermions; dimension 2; charge q=-1/2, multiplicity 1; charge q=1/2, multiplicity 1
Purification leg
An additional local degree of freedom using the same space as the physical leg; dimension 2; charge q=-1/2, multiplicity 1; charge q=1/2, multiplicity 1
Extra global charge leg
Attached to the tangent center, separately from virtual bonds and operator auxiliary legs; dimension 1; charge q=1, multiplicity 1
Chain length (number of sites)
16
Actual virtual bond dimensions (cut after site → dimension)

two-site correlations

82

U(1) × SU(2) symmetry · Contraction and reduction of recursive environments into a tangent center · rightward · Hubbard fermion model · MPO with a purification leg, tangent center with an extra charge leg · Center bond dimension=511: Workload and measurement settings

Contract the complete vector of precomputed recursive environment partials with the opposite-side base environments, then reduce the channel contributions into one tangent center. Preparation of the partials is outside the timed region.
